meta.title: perf: optimize event type query by using team IDs instead of complex join
meta.body_summary: Optimize query in EventTypeRepository.findById by first fetching user team IDs and using an IN clause instead of a complex join with the Team table, reducing query complexity.

perf_labels.notes: Devin optimized query with a single commit; zomars approved based on CI E2E pass and no perf evidence required.

review_details.performance_claim: Query optimization by replacing complex join with IN query on user team IDs, improving efficiency.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Database query optimization within a repository pattern; Devin successfully replaced a join with a two-step ID fetch and IN clause, and merged without performance benchmarks.

core_change_summary.description: In eventType.ts, modified findById to call findUserTeamIds from MembershipRepository and use a where clause with teamId in (...), handling empty teams and null teamId edge cases. Added findUserTeamIds method in membership.ts.
